name: robust_regression_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP and VWAP algorithms executing large directional orders create persistent micro-trends over 3-7 minute windows. Individual block trades and sudden micro-news events generate outlier bars that bias OLS regression and obscure the genuine institutional flow direction; Huber IRLS down-weights these spike bars (residual > 1.35 * MAD) to reveal the true gradient of underlying demand. When the Huber slope t-statistic exceeds 2.0 on a 5-minute window (60 bars) and price dips back below the regression line, we are entering a confirmed TWAP buy-flow at a momentary intraday imbalance point — the ongoing order execution will absorb that imbalance and push spot back through the trend line within 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Huber-IRLS regression on 5-min window shows t-stat > 2.0 uptrend and price dips below the regression line, signaling a TWAP-supported pullback entry
